products.name: Netskope Secure Web Gateway (SWG) Deployment & Web Filtering — Commercial
products.short_description: Stand up the Netskope Secure Web Gateway as a cloud chokepoint for web traffic — URL categorization, web-filtering policy, and consistent enforcement on or off network — deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Put every user's web traffic behind one cloud secure web gateway

Web traffic is where most threats and data loss start, yet many organizations still rely on patchy filtering that remote users bypass entirely. This solution stands up the Netskope Secure Web Gateway (SWG) as a cloud-delivered chokepoint for web traffic — URL categorization, web-filtering policy, threat and content controls, and consistent enforcement on or off the corporate network — deployed safely with a pilot-first, rollback-ready method.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — how a cloud SWG works, traffic steering into Netskope, URL categorization and web-filtering policy, threat/content controls, and the on/off-network enforcement model.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (a Netskope tenant + SWG, Entra ID identity, Intune for client/cert delivery, DNS/egress, a pilot group, change control) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: confirm tenant and identity, define web-filtering and categorization policy, steer pilot traffic, validate enforcement and user experience, then pilot, validate, and expand fleet-wide.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — SWG-readiness discovery, client/steering validation, a web-traffic and policy-coverage report, safe remediation of mis-steered devices, and a target group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Every user's web traffic behind one cloud secure web gateway — categorized, filtered, and consistently enforced wherever they work — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • NSSWG-Discovery.ps1 — Secure Web Gateway deployment readiness across Entra, Intune, and Netskope
    • NSSWG-Remediation.ps1 — safely fix mis-steered / non-compliant devices (default -WhatIf)
    • NSSWG-Report.ps1 — steering-scope coverage and (optional) web-activity report
    • NSSWG-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — create/populate the SWG steering-scope Entra groups
    • NSSWG-Validation.ps1 — confirm SWG steering is active on THIS device

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
